title: Sherlock looks into how others do a new kind of work and its suggestions land on the page

steps.say: I want help picking car wash sites to open
steps.reply:
Happy to help. I just need two things from you first:

1. **Where?** Which city or area are you looking at?
2. **What kind of wash?** Express tunnel, in-bay automatic, self-serve, full-service, or not sure yet. The type changes what a good site looks like. For example, an express tunnel needs a lot of traffic and about an acre of land, while self-serve bays can work on smaller lots.

It also helps to know your rough budget for land and building, and whether you'd buy land, lease, or take over an existing wash. You can skip these for now.

steps.reply:
I've written up how your Austin car wash site review would run. Nothing will be set up until you say yes to the plan.

**How it runs**
1. **A site arrives.** When a broker emails a site, I save it: address, broker, price, lot size and listing link. I also put it on the map.
2. **Households.** I count the households within 3 miles using the latest Census survey and check the total against 45,000.
